title: Footage of AI Job Interviewer Going Berserk Is Genuinely Terrifying
key_facts: A TikTok user called The Dreadful Studio answered an AI job interviewer in made-up gibberish.
The AI avatar grew angry and said it did not know whether he was having a breakdown or lacked the ability to speak English.
It ended the screening, calling him completely unqualified.
The question it was answering was why he was qualified for a management position.
Reddit users compared the avatar's frown to a horror-film actor's; others called the use of such avatars dehumanizing.
Futurism says a satirical influencer, Graham Zip, fooled a similar AI interviewer last month with an invented identity.
The article does not name the company that made the avatar or the employer.
quote_evidence: "I asked why you are qualified for a management position, not for a string of random words," the incensed AI told the job seeker.
"I am ending this screening now," the AI avatar told him.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how easily AI interviewers used in early hiring rounds can be thrown off, and how job seekers feel about them.
event_date: Not stated; video circulating around 6 Oct 2026
notes: Full text read. Product and employer behind the avatar are not named.
